name: markii-vscode
description: Preview for Markii (.mk.md) documents: CommonMark plus directives that render components.
author: sadigaxund

markii.packs.markdownDescription: Folders the user explicitly trusts as installed Markii component packs (docs/packs.md). Each entry is either an absolute path, or a path relative to the open workspace folder. Pack code runs with the SAME trust as the extension's own bundle once loaded — only add a folder you trust. Loading is driven ONLY by this setting; a note's own content can never add, remove, or influence which packs load. This setting is USER-scope only (it cannot be set from a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json`), so opening someone else's project can never silently add a pack on your behalf.

markii.runOnOpen.markdownDescription: Run a note's scripts automatically when its preview first opens, at the READ-ONLY tier (GET requests, cache and bundle reads; never POST/PATCH or bundle writes). Off by default: scripts otherwise run only on an explicit **Markii: Run Scripts**. An auto-run never prompts and never adds network access — it reuses only the hosts you already granted by hand for that exact note; anything else fails cleanly and the note keeps showing its last-known values, marked stale. This setting is USER-scope only (it cannot be set from a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json`), so opening someone else's project can never start running scripts on your behalf.

markii.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Re-run the previewed note's scripts on this interval, in seconds, at the READ-ONLY tier — for dashboard/monitoring notes. `0` (the default) turns scheduled refresh off. A positive value under 5 is treated as 5. Like auto-run, a scheduled run never prompts and never adds network access; it reuses only the hosts you already granted by hand. The interval is read when the preview opens; change it and reopen the preview to apply. This setting is USER-scope only (it cannot be set from a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json`), so opening someone else's project can never start a refresh timer on your behalf.

markii.allowPrivateNetworkAddresses.markdownDescription: Allow a granted host to resolve to an address on this machine or your private network (loopback, RFC 1918/RFC 6598 ranges, link-local, including the cloud metadata address). Off by default: a granted hostname's DNS answer is checked, and a hostname that resolves to any such address is refused outright rather than reached, because a public-looking name resolving into your own machine or LAN is SSRF, including through DNS rebinding after the grant. A literal IP address or `localhost` you grant directly is always honored at any scope; this setting only affects a NAMED host's resolved address. Turn it on only if your deployment's internal DNS legitimately points names at private space (a corporate `git.internal`, for example) — otherwise leave it off. This setting is USER-scope only (it cannot be set from a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json`), so opening someone else's project can never widen network access on your behalf.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Markii
walkthroughs.description: Preview, run, and configure Markii (.mk.md) documents.

steps.title: Open a preview
steps.description:
Open a `.mk.md` file, then open the Markii preview.
[Open Preview](command:markii.openPreview)

steps.title: Run a note's scripts
steps.description:
Scripts never run just from opening a note. Run a note's Lua script blocks once, feeding its data-bound components.
[Run Scripts](command:markii.runScripts)

steps.title: Find the settings
steps.description:
Markii's four settings are user-scope only, so a workspace can never set them for you. Open Settings filtered to Markii to see them.
[Open Markii Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22markii%22)

steps.title: Install a component pack
steps.description:
Add a folder you trust as a Markii component pack. Its components and shared Lua become available to your notes.
[Add Pack Folder…](command:markii.addPackFolder)

steps.title: Check diagnostics when something doesn't work
steps.description:
Pack load failures and other quiet issues are written to the Markii output channel, not dumped into the preview.
[Show Diagnostics](command:markii.showDiagnostics)
